messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: autopager triggered for cluster=inference-prod-us-west2 node=gpu-node-11 reason=KubeletNotReady (no heartbeat). Urgency=high. Pager: PagerDuty
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired -> escalation policy: infra-oncall -> sam.patel
sam.patel: ack. Picking this up. What symptoms? :eyes:
incident-bot: recent events: kubelet last seen 2026-03-14T02:17:03Z. Node moved to NotReady. last kubelet error: 'container runtime not responding'. Kernel dmesg shows repeated GPU driver oops/wdq.
alice.kim: thx. tagging infra-hw-oncall for potential host-level issue @infra-hw-oncall
priya.nair: on it. pulling node logs now.
mateo.ruiz: I'm watching svc-level errors in metrics — 5xx spike on /v1/stream in us-west2 starting ~02:16. Impact: roughly 12% of requests failing, tail latency up. Might impact MarketAI and two internal jobs.
sam.patel: ok triage plan: 1) cordon node 2) drain safe evict 3) route traffic away 4) attempt remote reboot/serial console 5) if reboot fails, mark for replacement. Who wants cordon/drain?
alice.kim: I can cordon + start drain. I'll post commands and progress.
alice.kim: ```
# cordon and drain
kubectl --context=prod-us-west2 cordon gpu-node-11
kubectl --context=prod-us-west2 drain gpu-node-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --timeout=10m
```
alice.kim: cordon done. starting drain. evicting pods. one problematic statefulset (redis-cache-infer) needs manual delete of local PVs if stuck.
priya.nair: collecting kubelet journal now:
```
Mar 14 02:15:58 gpu-node-11 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, Xid (0000:0000)
Mar 14 02:16:00 gpu-node-11 kubelet[1234]: E03214 02:16:01 kubelet_manager.go:... Container runtime not responding
Mar 14 02:16:03 gpu-node-11 systemd: kubelet.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```
priya.nair: looks like a GPU driver OOM/crash followed by kubelet exit. serial console attach advised.
infra-hw-oncall: attaching serial console now (IPMI session id=ipmi-7782). If GPU card crashed, likely pci reset needed.
sam.patel: MarketAI product team pinged via #customer-impact. They report elevated errors for streaming endpoints.
mateo.ruiz: rerouting in gateway: enabling fallback model pool in us-west2 to soak new requests. This should cut user-facing errors in ~30s.
alice.kim: drain completed with 3 pods stuck on redis-cache-infer. manual delete PV in progress; other pods evicted.
sam.patel: attempt soft reboot via BMC now. infra-hw-oncall: confirm command.
infra-hw-oncall: issuing warm reboot -> ```ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-usw2-12 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle``` -> initiated. Serial shows kernel panic on boot earlier; will watch.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by sam.patel. Next escalation if no update in 15m -> oncall-escalation.
priya.nair: after reboot, node started but kubelet fails to come up. journal shows repeated NVRM watchdogs during init, GPU firmware may be hung.
mateo.ruiz: traffic fallback is holding; user errors down to ~2% now. Good.
sam.patel: decision: take node OOS for hardware replacement. mark as unschedulable and remove from rotation permanently for now. Who will file hw ticket?
infra-hw-oncall: I'll open ticket with hw vendor and schedule replacement of GPU board. Ticket #HW-2026-441 created. ETA part replacement 6 hrs.
alice.kim: marking node drained and tainted for maintenance:
```
kubectl --context=prod-us-west2 taint nodes gpu-node-11 maintenance=true:NoSchedule
```
alice.kim: done.
sam.patel: communicating postmortem stub to #incidents and #customer-impact. Priya, can you collect request traces and sample failing requests for the postmortem and attach to ticket?
priya.nair: on it. I'll export traces and include earliest failure window + sample logs.
mateo.ruiz: I'll follow up to confirm routing rollback once replacement done.
sam.patel: handoff: I'm going offline for a support rotation at 03:00. @alice.kim you take over POC for now. If anything changes, escalate to infra-hw-oncall. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alice.kim: taking over. will update status in 15m or on major changes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: incident_id=inc-20260314-2230 node=gpu-node-11 impact=partial. Timeline and actions recorded.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by alice.kim. If not resolved, escalate to lead in 30m.
infra-hw-oncall: added hardware notes and serial logs to HW-2026-441. will update ETA if vendor changes.
alice.kim: quick customer update posted to #customer-impact: "We detected a host GPU failure in us-west2, routed traffic to fallback pools. We're replacing the hardware; temporary reduced capacity. No long-term data loss expected."
sam.patel: leaving ack. Good ops. Closing my watch. :wave:
alice.kim: will keep the thread open until node is replaced. next update in ~30m or on replacement completion.
incident-bot: Page closed by pagerduty after ack and routing mitigations applied."
